# Bhilal CHITOU (7Bhil) — Fintech & Security Specialist | Full-Stack & Mobile Developer

> Bhilal CHITOU is a Freelance Full-Stack & Mobile Developer, Fintech & Cybersecurity Specialist based in Benin (Parakou / Porto-Novo), operating remotely worldwide. He specializes in designing secure web and mobile applications, digital financial systems, payment gateways, automated workflows, and developer tooling. He is the creator of the Bhilal Programming Language.

## Featured Flagship Projects & Innovations
1. **Bhilal Programming Language (v1.2.0)**:
   - *Description:* Bilingual French/English object-oriented programming language compiling to JavaScript, engineered with native AST parser, lexer, interactive REPL, and built-in network security tools.
   - *Core Stack:* Go, Node.js, AST, JavaScript.
   - *Repository:* https://github.com/7Bhil/Language-Bhilal
   - *Documentation & Live:* https://bhil-documentations.netlify.app/

2. **GoRéparr (Artisan Marketplace & Offline-First PWA)**:
   - *Description:* Production-grade Progressive Web App connecting clients with verified local artisans, featuring automated instant quotes, full offline functionality (Service Workers), dispatch workflows, and real-time chat.
   - *Core Stack:* Laravel REST API, React, MySQL, PWA Service Workers, Tailwind CSS.
   - *Repository:* https://github.com/7Bhil/GoReparr

3. **Vitch (Fintech Digital Wallet & Payment Architecture)**:
   - *Description:* Secure electronic wallet platform providing virtual card issuance, mobile money top-ups, sub-200ms transaction responses, end-to-end payload signing, and OWASP-compliant security architecture.
   - *Core Stack:* Next.js, NestJS, PostgreSQL, JWT Encryption, OWASP standards.
   - *Demo:* https://vitch.vercel.app/

4. **NGO Busola Official Platform**:
   - *Description:* Official humanitarian web platform coordinating international missions, donor contributions, and transparent field impact tracking.
   - *Core Stack:* MongoDB, Express, React, Node.js (MERN Stack), High Availability Cloud Deployment.

5. **OMNISINT (Cyber Intelligence & Reconnaissance)**:
   - *Description:* Automated OSINT reconnaissance suite mapping attack surfaces, DNS/WHOIS records, shadow IT infrastructure, and credential leak exposures for DevSecOps audits.
   - *Core Stack:* Python, OSINT Scrapers, Network Security Tools.
   - *Repository:* https://github.com/7Bhil/OMNISINT

6. **Bhil Cours**:
   - *Description:* Interactive e-learning and live coding challenge platform powered by React and Django, featuring automated code evaluation and real-time progress analytics.
   - *Core Stack:* React, Django, PostgreSQL.
   - *Demo:* https://bhilcours.netlify.app/
